chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 108 - The Dragon’s Gambit: Ji Clan's Last Stand Formation
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning reveals the legendary Blackflame Dragon Prison Formation as the Ji Clan prepares for a desperate three-day siege against Snowdragon Mountain. Hope is reborn.
og_description: A hidden treasure turns the tide of despair as the Ji Clan entrenches at Oxhorn Mountain, ready to gamble everything on a three-day stall.
twitter_description: Ji Ning drops a legendary formation on his clan's last stand. The patriarch cries. Hope is back on the menu.
